integrity: Claims rest on a complete path-coordinate proof and separately executed finite-field checker; no independent external audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Only targets with every length-two path coefficient nonzero are covered. No formula for targets outside this principal torus, no scheme-theoretic multiplicity claim, and no absolute historical-priority certification. Computations cover finite fields and sizes, not all cases.
title: Parity and square-class fibers of squaring on the principal torus of a cyclic Nakayama radical
